scripts.setup: echo 'Voraussetzung: Java 21 fuer backend/book-api' && test -f packages/database/.env || cp packages/database/.env.example packages/database/.env && test -f packages/web/.env || cp packages/web/.env.example packages/web/.env && test -f packages/mcp/.env || cp packages/mcp/.env.example packages/mcp/.env && pnpm install && pnpm run db:start && pnpm --filter @book-manager/database migrate && pnpm --filter @book-manager/database seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run web:dev" "pnpm run api:dev"
scripts.clean: docker compose down && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/.next packages/*/dist packages/*/.turbo
